title: How Target Brings Its Team Together Around What’s Next
summary: See how Target Together 2026 brought team members together around Target’s strategy, guests and what’s next for the company.
body_markdown:
Thousands of Target team members gathered for Target Together 2026, a multi-day event centered on connection, recognition and the work of bringing Target’s strategy to life.


What guests experience at Target is shaped by teams across stores, supply chain, headquarters and global offices. At Target Together, teams connected with colleagues from across the business, heard from Target leaders and inspiring guest speakers, and immersed themselves in plans for the upcoming holiday season.


This year’s theme, Win as One, highlighted the collective strength of one team aligned to one strategy designed to deliver the most delightful experience in retail.


Here’s a look at Target Together 2026.


Previous slide


-


**Together in Minneapolis and beyond.** More than 10,000 team members gathered in Minneapolis, with thousands more joining virtually for several days to celebrate Team Target, rally around our strategy and build momentum into Target's biggest season.


-


**Setting our sights on what’s next.** At the Win as One main event at the Target Center, CEO **Michael Fiddelke** and leaders from across the company spoke about the priorities in front of us, from staying close to guests to strengthening our team and showing up for communities.


-


**A first look at holiday.** Immersive merchandise showcases gave teams a closer look at the style, value, newness and discovery guests will find throughout the season.


-


**Crossing paths and sharing perspectives.** Between sessions and experiences, colleagues from different parts of Target had time to meet, learn from one another and build relationships beyond their everyday work.


-


**Recognizing leadership and impact.** The week celebrated team members and field leaders whose contributions strengthen their teams and shape the experiences we create for guests.


-


**Connected to our communities.** Moments throughout the week reflected the role our teams play in the places where we live, work and serve.


-


**Carrying it forward.** The momentum from the week now moves into stores, facilities and offices around the world as teams turn toward the busy holiday season and what comes next.
